summary: A Doctor's gear priorities are, in order: HEAL MULTIPLIER (stat 0x217 - a straight percentage on every heal it will ever cast, and the one stat no other class competes for), Biological Metamorphosis and Matter Metamorphosis (which decide which rung of the heal ladder it can stand on), Treatment and First Aid (which gate every implant, symbiant and kit QL), Nano C. Init (cast and recharge speed = healing throughput), Max Nano / Nano Pool / nano-cost reduction (the fight timer), Max NCU (it runs more standing buffs than anyone), and Max Health / Body Dev. (because healing makes it the aggro magnet and it has no reflect, no absorb and cost-3.2 close-combat evades). Everything in this file was read out of items.ocp with tools/eng-gear-extractor --prof 10 and cross-checked against itemnames.sql - no bonus figure here is from a website. Path: cheap sided/Carbonum -> the SL Doctor Suit quest chain (First Tier -> Second Tier -> Chosen or Faithful) -> Azure Reveries or Miy's Nano on Rubi-Ka -> Ofab Doctor from Battlestation VP -> Combined Paramedic's from alien raids, with heal-multiplier utility items layered on top at every stage. Implants are in doctor-implants.json, symbiants in doctor-symbiants.json and weapons in doctor-weapons.json; they are excluded here.
_method: tools/eng-gear-extractor (--prof 10 --wield) reads every ToWear/ToWield template in the OmniCell items.ocp pack (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3, client 18.8.50_EP1, 120,842 templates; 61,458 of them wearable by a Doctor after applying the profession-lock rule) and emits each item's slot bitmask, ToWear criteria, profession lock, NODROP/Unique flags and worn stat bonuses. Every 'keyBonuses' number below is the QL300 (or top-QL) record for that exact item id. Items whose ToWear carries a Profession EqualTo lock that excludes Doctor(10) are not in the dump at all.

_deviations: The whole file is organised around a stat the MP gear file never mentions: HEAL MULTIPLIER (stat 0x217). It gets its own top-level section because it is a percentage applied to every heal a Doctor casts and because only 66 items in the entire Doctor-wearable dump grant it - it is a scarce, class-defining stat in a way that nothing in an MP's gear list is. The MP file's equivalent organising stat is nano skill, which for a Doctor is a means, not the end.

The Doctor's alien set is Combined PARAMEDIC'S (246631-246656), not the MP's Combined Officer's. The client data shows why the difference matters: Paramedic's is a Max Health / Body Dev. / Max Nano / Nano Pool / nano-cost set with no nano SKILL bonuses at all, whereas the Officer's line the MP file describes is a nano-skill and trade-skill set. A Doctor is buying survivability and sustain there, not casting ceiling.

Ofab Doctor ranks ABOVE Miy's Nano here, the reverse of the MP file's ordering. Read from items.ocp: the Ofab Doctor set carries Treatment (+50 on the back piece), First Aid (+45 on the sleeves), Heal Multiplier (+2 on the back piece), Computer Literacy (+24 on the pants) and +82 total Max NCU - none of which Miy's Nano has at any QL. Miy's spreads one nano skill per piece, which suits a class that needs six schools evenly; a Doctor needs BM and MM specifically.

Azure Reveries is promoted from the MP file's 'budget' tier to 'high'. The Loren's upgrade (304609-304614) requires no expansion at all and no profession, and between six pieces it gives Treatment, First Aid, BM, MM, MC, PM, SI, TS, +25 Nano C. Init, -10% nano cost, +108 Max NCU and +2050 Max Health. For a FROOB Doctor - which is a real and common thing, because the froob heal kit is nearly complete - it is the best set in the game.

A 'weapon' appears in the gear list. Doctor's Left Hand of Grace (267618) occupies the LeftHand weapon slot but its whole purpose is +5 Heal Multiplier, so it is catalogued here as well as in doctor-weapons.json. The MP file has no equivalent - an MP's weapon is never a healing item.

Every number in this file is read from items.ocp per item id. The MP gear file quotes several set-level figures from wiki.aodb.us and marks the exact per-QL stat lines as unverified; that gap does not exist here because the eng-gear-extractor pass was run for profession 10 specifically.

No NCU-versus-armor tradeoff discussion of Grid Armor. The MP file lists Grid Armor as a situational full-body alternative; for a Doctor it is not a consideration at all, because Grid Armor occupies the Body/Back/Arm slots that carry the Doctor's Max Nano, Treatment and Heal Multiplier pieces (Ofab Doctor Body +1000 Max Nano, OFAB Doctor Protective Gear +50 Treatment / +2 Heal Multiplier).
_unverified: Combat Medic's Light Tank Armor: named by wiki.aodb.us Doctor:Armor as a classic-Rubi-Ka Doctor set dropping from Biomare Neutralizers and enhancing BM/MM/Treatment/First Aid. Its item ids and stat block were NOT located in the local extraction in this pass, so no numbers are given and slotsCovered is 'unknown'. Treat as a lead.

De'Valos Sleeves (253184/253185) carry a 'Breed EqualTo 3' (Nanomage) criterion in their flattened ToWear list. The extractor flattens the criteria tree, so an OR-group would look identical to a hard AND lock. This was NOT resolved. If you are not a Nanomage, verify in game before planning around this item.

Combined Paramedic's ToWear also carries 'HairTexture BitAnd 65536' (stat 65) on every piece. What that criterion gates is unknown - it appears on the whole Combined armor family and is recorded verbatim rather than interpreted.

DROP LOCATIONS are the weakest part of this file and that is a known structural gap: items.ocp carries requirements and bonuses but not loot tables, and auno.org / aoitems.com are blocked to automation per the playbook. Where a source is given (Ofab = Battlestation VP, Combined Paramedic's = alien raid parts, Miy's = Medusae, Doctor Suit chain = SL quests) it is from the wiki or the item's own name/expansion gate, not from a verified drop table. Sluggish Notum Lens (302931), Sacred Chalice (305523), Ancient Resorative Fungus (302925), Nano Assistant (269187), Memory of Future Events (305516) and Notum Ring of the Three (305489) have NO source recorded at all.
Miy's Nano Armor: the wiki's 'drops from Medusae' attribution is carried over from the MP gear file and was not independently re-verified here. The stat block IS verified from items.ocp.

The Ofab upgrade path (Ofab -> Improved -> Penultimate, paid for with Victory Points) is stated from wiki.aodb.us Doctor:Armor plus the three parallel id blocks visible in items.ocp. The VP costs per tier were not sourced.

'Heal Multiplier' unit and stacking: the stat is read as an integer bonus from items.ocp (e.g. +5, +10) and wiki.aodb.us describes the Specialist Healer perk as '21% healing effectiveness' at 10 tiers of +2/+3. The mapping from the integer to a percentage, and whether multiple sources add linearly, was NOT derived. Do not compute an expected heal from these numbers.
Only the QL1 and QL300 (or top-QL) records exist per template in the pack; intermediate QLs interpolate in game. All figures quoted are the top-QL record unless a QL is stated.

This file curates from a 61,458-item Doctor-wearable dump; it is explicitly NOT the exhaustive per-slot catalogue that playbook section 9 requires. That catalogue would be a 'doctor-equippable.json' and does not exist yet for any class.
